caseName: Stebbins v. U.S. Dist. Court for the W. Dist. of Ark.
caseNameFull: David Anthony STEBBINS v. UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE WESTERN DISTRICT OF ARKANSAS.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
